description: This Java source file defines the class ThingErrorResponse, which is an immutable response object representing an error that occurred during the processing of a ThingCommand. It wraps a DittoRuntimeException and provides methods for creating instances from exceptions, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for the related Thing ID and the exception details.

classes.name: ThingErrorResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing an error response for Thing commands, encapsulating a DittoRuntimeException and related Thing ID, with methods for JSON serialization, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods for creating ThingErrorResponse instances from exceptions, Thing IDs, JSON strings, or JSON objects.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ThingErrorResponse instance from a JSON string or JSON object, deserializing the stored exception.

methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the resource path, which in this case is empty.

methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.
